subject: SOC 2: Incident notification, IRP evidence acknowledgement and next steps
messages:
From: Alice Nguyen <alice@finovent.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: security-ops@finovent.com
Date: 2028-01-09T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Initial notification: authentication anomaly observed (Jan 9)

Hi Evelyn,

We observed a spike in failed authentication attempts hitting our integration with Redwood between 06:45-07:10 PST this morning. The spike affected a small subset of API clients; no sensitive data exfiltration has been identified on our side, but we need to complete our SOC 2 impact assessment and evidence collection.

Please confirm the following as soon as possible:
- Do you have an Incident Response Plan (IRP) we can reference for SOC 2 evidence?
- Can you provide an initial timeline of events, and a redacted log bundle showing auth events for 2028-01-09 06:00–08:00 PST?
- We will need a SIG/CAIQ mapping or a note of where specific controls evidence lives.

Our timeline is tight — our compliance team needs an acknowledgement and an evidence handoff plan by EOD 2028-01-10. Preferred transfer methods are SFTP or a secured shared Drive link.

For context: our contact for evidence intake is security-ops@finovent.com.

Thanks,
Alice Nguyen
Security Program Manager, Finovent
[Attachment: finovent_alert_screenshot.png (image/png)]

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Nguyen <alice@finovent.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-01-09T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Initial notification: authentication anomaly observed (Jan 9)

Alice — thank you for the heads up and for the screenshot. We take these reports seriously. Quick acknowledgement: we have initiated our IRP and are preparing an evidence package. High-level plan below and we will follow up with the artifact transfer details by 1700 PST today.

Planned immediate actions
- Triage & containment: review ingress service logs and rotate any affected service credentials (in progress).
- Evidence extraction: pull auth logs and request tracing for 06:00–08:00 PST (ETA for raw extract: 14:00 PST).
- Redaction & packaging: we will produce a redacted log bundle and a redaction index for SOC 2 ingestion (ETA: 17:00 PST).
- IRP + control mapping: attach the current IRP and SIG/CAIQ response template for your SOC 2 team to review.

Question for you: do you prefer SFTP upload (we can provision a temporary inbound path) or a secured Drive link? We can support either.

I am copying Marissa (Security Ops) and Karthik (Engineering lead) to coordinate the artifacts.

Regards,
Evelyn Hart
Head of Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: pending: redwood_irp_v3.2.pdf (will attach in final message)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Date: 2028-01-09T13:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Initial notification: authentication anomaly observed (Jan 9) — evidence prep

Evelyn / Karthik — working through the extraction now. Notes and ask below so we keep Finovent's SOC 2 scope clean: 

Extraction steps (in-progress)
1) Pull auth gateway logs (ingress proxies) for 2028-01-09 05:50–08:30 PST; include request ID, timestamp, client_id, outcome (200/401/429), and upstream latency.
2) Query token service for issuance/validation events correlated by request ID.
3) Collect service account rotation audit entries between 2028-01-01 and 2028-01-09 for context.

Redaction plan
- PII removal: remove or hash user identifiers (email/SSO id) with one-way salted hash; preserve request ID mapping in redaction_index.csv for auditor-only access.
- Remove ephemeral headers (X-Forwarded-For) except when needed for IP-based correlation; provide an IP summary separately.

SIG/CAIQ mapping
- I will populate sig-response-template.xlsx with control pointers (where logs/configs live, retention policies and the specific evidence files).

Transfer method recommendation
- Recommend SFTP (secure, auditable) — I can request a temporary inbound path from Finovent and we will upload extracted-logs-20280109.tar.gz there. If they prefer Drive, we'll upload to the shared folder and set limited access.

Attachments we will produce for Finovent
- extracted-logs-20280109.tar.gz (redacted logs)
- redaction_index.csv (mapping file for auditors)
- sig-response-template.xlsx (control crosswalk)

I will kick off the redaction job now and flag if we need to expand the window.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redaction_index.csv (spreadsheet stub)]

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Nguyen <alice@finovent.com>, security-ops@finovent.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-01-09T17:05:00-08:00
Subject: SOC 2 evidence delivery: IRP and redacted log bundle (initial)

Alice / Finovent security team — attaching our Incident Response Plan and the initial evidence bundle for your SOC 2 intake. This message is the formal acknowledgement you requested earlier today.

What we are delivering now (initial package)
- redwood_irp_v3.2.pdf — current incident response plan (last updated 2027-11-18).
- extracted-logs-20280109.tar.gz — redacted log archive for 2028-01-09 06:00–08:00 PST (contains ingress, token service events).
- redaction_index.csv — mapping of hashed identifiers to request IDs (auditor-only).
- sig-response-template.xlsx — control crosswalk showing where related evidence is stored and retention windows.

Transfer method
- Uploaded to your inbound SFTP at sftp://uploads.finovent.com/inbound/finovent_evidence_20280109. If you did not provision the path, please let us know and we will provide a secured Drive link instead (Drive link included below for convenience).

Preliminary summary
- Scope: spike in 401s primarily tied to repeated invalid token validation attempts from a set of client_ids.
- Impact: Auth failures only; no confirmed token misuse or data extraction.
- Containment: rotated short-lived service credentials for affected client tokens and enforced additional rate limiting for the window.
- Next steps: full post-incident write-up and root cause analysis (RCA) to follow once we complete deeper tracing (ETA for RCA: 2028-01-12).

Links and access
- Drive (read-only, auditor access): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C_example_evidence
- SFTP upload path: SFTP://uploads.finovent.com/inbound/finovent_evidence_20280109

If you need anything redacted differently or additional fields in the logs for your auditors, reply and we will prioritize.

Regards,
Evelyn Hart
Head of Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
